collection.title: Ford C-Max C-Max MPV 2015 to 2019 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: The Ford C-Max 2015 - 2019 version requires a 29" wiper blade on the drivers side with a 25" for the passengers side and all of the following wiper blades are designed to fit this vehicle. This model uses the Pinch Tab arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm. We also have a rear wiper blades available for this model, just click the Rear Blades tab below.
